            source
            def LargeIndecomposable.IsBGRSSourceCriticalPath {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [HasWellDefinedBGRSRayProduct C] {i j : RayVertex (BGRSRayCategory C)} (p : Quiver.Path i j) :
            Prop

            Source-faithful BGRS criticality: the path is singular with independent representatives, and every contiguous subpath obtained by deleting exactly one arrow is stable. Such a subpath is necessarily the path with its first or last arrow deleted.

              rayPathMap middle ≠ 0

              Every strictly shorter contiguous subpath of a critical singular path has nonzero ray evaluation. The witnessing arrow lift for the critical path is nonzero on the subpath; if its ray evaluation vanished, that subpath would itself be a shorter singular subpath.
